the East Coast. It’s 102 degrees F outside and
the mayor has asked the residents to keep
My window unit doesn’t do much on days like
this, so it’s set to 74. It doesn’t bring the
There’s a backlash online. Social media is full of
people asserting their right to set their
thermostat at whatever temperature they want.
My elderly cat looks like he’s given up on life.
How many more days like this will we have this summer?
How many more days next summer, and the summer after it?
And if the power grid can’t handle everyone’s ACs as it is,
what happens when summers get even hotter? And what happens

I decided to take a closer look at the data.
